title: SvgRadialGradient
responsibility: Renders the native radialGradient element without extra wrapper DOM or feature behavior.

inputs.name: SvgRadialGradient.children
inputs.description: An optional Svelte snippet whose rendered output becomes the content of the radialGradient element; when omitted, the element is rendered with no content. The snippet is invoked with no arguments, is a function rather than a JSON value, and is not validated by the component.

outputs.name: SvgRadialGradient
outputs.description: The native SVG radialGradient element, rendered in the SVG namespace declared by the component, with every prop other than children forwarded to it as attributes and the children snippet rendered inside it. No wrapper element is added, and the element is always rendered, even when no props or children are given.
